verseText: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.
intro: October is here! Learn what Jesus says about being a light, open your Bible, move, pray, and enjoy this month's new CMBC coloring page and activity sheet.

read.title: Open Your Bible
read.text: Find Matthew 5:14. Read it out loud with somebody in your family. Who does Jesus say is the light of the world?

move.title: Shine Your Light
move.text: Reach up like a lighthouse beam, turn slowly in a circle, then point outward and say: I can be a light for Jesus!

learn.title: Bible Challenge
learn.question: According to Matthew 5:14, what are we called to be?

artistWallMessage: October's Light of the World coloring page and activity sheet are here!
completionMessage: 🏆 October Bible Adventure Complete! Keep shining your light for Jesus!
